name: Luma AI
h1: Luma AI ARR: ~$80M Estimated on a $4B Valuation.
intro: Luma AI has never disclosed an ARR figure. Third-party estimates put it near $80M annualized in 2026, while the company raised a $900M Series C led by Saudi Arabia's Humain at a $4B+ valuation to fund the Project Mars supercluster. The timeline below blends those estimates with disclosed funding events.

Estimated run rate in the tens of millions as Dream Machine subscriptions and Ray2 model API usage ramp.

milestones.note: Sacra reports Luma seeking ~$1.1B at a $3.2B valuation as Dream Machine passes tens of millions of users and 2025 revenue runs in the tens of millions.

Current estimates put annualized revenue near ~$80M across Dream Machine subscriptions and the Ray-series video API for enterprise and marketers.

modelTitle: How Creator Plans Fund a Per-Second Video API.
modelParagraphs: Luma monetizes Dream Machine with tiered subscriptions — self-serve plans historically running from roughly $10/month for casual creators to ~$100/month for heavy professionals, billed by generation counts — plus a free tier that seeds the funnel among its 30M+ users. The consumer and prosumer plans carry most of today's revenue.

The larger bet is API and enterprise: the Ray-series video models are sold per second of generation to developers, agencies and platforms, and the Humain partnership ties Luma to sovereign compute in Saudi Arabia — Project Mars capacity that underwrites enterprise-scale video generation. Revenue today is modest relative to the $4B valuation; the round is priced on the enterprise ramp ahead.
revenueMix: Tiered creator plans from roughly $10 to ~$100/month with a free tier for its 30M+ users.
Ray-series models billed per second of generated video for developers and platforms.
Humain-backed capacity and enterprise contracts for marketer-scale video production.

faqs.q: What Is Luma AI's ARR in 2026?
faqs.a: Luma has never disclosed ARR. Third-party estimates put it around $80 million annualized in 2026, up from an estimated tens of millions in 2024–2025. The company's confirmed numbers are users (30M+ on Dream Machine) and funding, not revenue.

faqs.q: How Much Has Luma AI Raised and at What Valuation?
faqs.a: A $900 million Series C led by Saudi AI firm Humain in November 2025 valued Luma at $4 billion+, a ~13x step-up from the $3.2B it was reportedly seeking in August 2025. Total funding exceeds $1 billion.

faqs.q: What Does Luma AI Actually Sell?
faqs.a: Dream Machine video-generation subscriptions for creators and professionals, a per-second API for its Ray-series video models, and enterprise capacity — anchored by the Humain partnership and the Project Mars supercluster in Saudi Arabia.

faqs.q: How Reliable Are These Revenue Estimates?
faqs.a: Low confidence — Luma has not published revenue figures. The ARR points here are third-party estimates (Sacra, a16z ecosystem trackers) triangulated from users, pricing and funding disclosures; treat them as directional.

faqs.q: How Does Luma Compare With Runway and Other AI Video Startups?
faqs.a: Runway disclosed $200M ARR in September 2026 — roughly 2.5x Luma's estimated run rate — though Luma's $4B valuation is comparable to Runway's $5.3B. Luma's differentiation is sovereign compute via Humain and consumer reach via Dream Machine.

ctaTitle: Building Video AI Products? Monetize Them With Clink.
ctaDescription: Creator plans on one side, a per-second video API on the other. Clink meters both, manages the subscriptions and carries merchant-of-record tax in every market.
